value.name: listens to discharge planner message
value.description: Asha listens twice to a message saying the discharge planner needs a decision by Friday.
evidence: the discharge planner would need a decision by Friday. She listened to it twice, the second time with the volume lower

value.name: checks calendar against schedule
value.description: Asha opens her calendar and compares her Thursday and Friday obligations against the train timetable to Trenton.
evidence: opened her calendar and looked at the gap between Thursday's depositions and the Friday filing, measuring it against the timetable for the regional line into Trenton

value.name: receives Rosa ride offer
value.description: Rosa texts Asha that she has seen the Trenton messages and offers to give her a ride tomorrow.
evidence: the screen lit with a text from Rosa—Check your messages from Trenton. Let me know if you need a ride tomorrow—and Asha read it without answering
Rosa: I have the morning free. Just say the word and I'll pick you up at seven.

value.name: withholds response to Rosa
value.description: Asha does not answer Rosa immediately, sensing Rosa knew before she did or at least knew to ask.
evidence: Asha read it without answering, aware that Rosa had somehow known before she did, or had at least known to ask

value.name: rejects Rosa's ride offer
value.description: Asha replies that she has the schedule and will drive herself, sending a clipped refusal.
evidence: She typed back, I have the schedule. I will drive myself, and sent it before she could soften the line breaks
The refusal sat in her chest the way it had sat on the screen, clipped and a little colder than she had meant

value.name: avoids checking Rosa's reply
value.description: Asha sets the phone down again and deliberately does not look to see whether Rosa answered.
evidence: she did not turn the phone over to see whether Rosa had answered

value.name: returns home and opens laptop
value.description: At home, Asha places her phone on the kitchen counter and opens her laptop beside it.
evidence: At home she set the phone face up on the kitchen counter and opened her laptop beside it
